`npm test` is green again: 517 of 517 pass. Two of the five commits since v2.0.0 had broken the source, and I fixed both without touching the tests.

- **`958d3ae` (thousands separators in `formatMoney`):** it changed the cents padding from `padStart(2, "0")` to `padEnd`. 1 cent printed as `$0.10`, 9 cents as `$0.90`. I restored `padStart` in `src/money.js` and kept the separator logic. This fixed the four `formatMoney` failures and the `renderInvoice PIN-03 row` failure.
- **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork):** it set `taxable = subtotal`, so tax was computed on the subtotal instead of the subtotal minus the order-level discount code. I changed it to `subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`. This fixed the two `buildInvoice SPRING10 in CA-ON` failures and the `renderInvoice CA-ON SPRING10 total row` failure.

Line discounts are still applied inside `lineTotal`, so the subtotal is already net of them and nothing else those commits added was touched.
